experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:22600:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7435:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:936:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:76:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:22961:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21332:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2336:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4625:./reassess/r_3.md:7867:./reassess/r_3.md:2890:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1062:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1526:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:23945:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:24446:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17080:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:24502:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19910:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28409:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:39:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28412:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28565:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/remedy_rethink.md:89:`L_stable` 也不建议直接上。它可以做成非循环的训练 surrogate，但在 OD 上很可能退化成“把当前正样本推高、当前 top negative 推低”，本质接近 Smooth-AP / listwise metric loss 这类已有 ranking surrogate([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.12163?utm_source=openai))。除非你先证明 `L_stable` 对 tax 的解释在控制 1x margin 后还有显著 residual，否则别开训。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28773:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:2295:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:37:"mechanism": "CSSA learns pixel-level part labels without any external pose/parsing model: it separates foreground from background by the heuristic that foreground feature maps have stronger L2-norm response, clusters foreground pixels via k-means across a clip (Np=6 fixed clusters), and uses cluster IDs as pseudo-labels to iteratively train a pixel-wise part classifier producing Np+1 confidence maps (parts plus background/occlusion). A CARE module aggregates the whole clip into a denoised video-level embedding (encoder-decoder with an identity cross-entropy bottleneck) and uses its cross-pixel cosine similarity to each frame pixel as a weighted residual gate that amplifies pixels consistent with the dominant identity and suppresses clutter/occluders. SGFA then builds the global feature pair-wise: each semantic part's contribution to the aggregated global vector is weighted by the product of its query and gallery confidence scores, so a part counts only when reliable in both images.",

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30197:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3293:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3537:experiments/MORNING_REPORT.md:97:**decorr loss 全程活跃却完全没动 Jaccard/fusion。** 原因（这就是洞察）：强迫全局**线性**解相关，对"模型给 query 排哪些 gallery"（part-MaxSim 排序）是**正交**的——检索由 part-MaxSim over 相同可见身体部位证据决定，两模型受**同一份可见证据**约束、犯**同样的错**（Swin 对 370/989=37% 重遮挡 query 对、DINO 只补 8 个=0.81%）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30198:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3321:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3839:experiments/exp324i/design.md:23:4. **eval**：decorr-DINO part-MaxSim（heavy/all） + 复用 `exp324h_lora_oracle.py` 的 **adapted-DINO ⊕ Swin oracle + fusion sweep**，看 fusion 重遮挡/全部能否 **> Swin 72.57/75**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30199:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3338:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3995:experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:49:**decorr loss 全程活跃(稳 0.041)却完全没移动 Jaccard/oracle/fusion。** 机制：强迫 global 线性解相关对"排哪些 gallery"(part-MaxSim 排序)是**正交**的——检索由 part-MaxSim over 相同可见身体部位证据决定，两模型受**同一份可见证据**约束犯**同样的错**(Swin-only-r1-hit 370/989=37%，DINO 补 8=0.81%)。global 线性相关只是排序"装饰"。→ **显式施压也打不破张力 = 张力鲁棒、fundamental**。这是张力洞察最强的对照证据(诊断论文核心实验)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30998:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3697:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4588:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:4648:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4603:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:6013:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31000:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3699:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4629:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31048:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6069:`L_stable` 也不建议直接上。它可以做成非循环的训练 surrogate，但在 OD 上很可能退化成“把当前正样本推高、当前 top negative 推低”，本质接近 Smooth-AP / listwise metric loss 这类已有 ranking surrogate([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.12163?utm_source=openai))。除非你先证明 `L_stable` 对 tax 的解释在控制 1x margin 后还有显著 residual，否则别开训。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31169:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31932:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37607:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17080:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

codex
外部 2024-2026 检索确认：CLIP/属性/遮挡 prompt、ROA/真实遮挡增强、dynamic masked metric、DG/LReID/few-shot 都已有明确先例。剩下能站住的候选必须避开“直接 CLIP 对齐、visibility masked metric、生成/补全、测试侧重排”这些高拥挤区。
codex
结论：不能说“训练侧穷尽”。但在你给的约束下，真有 CCF-B 潜力的训练端空白很窄。我会保留 4 个候选，其他方向先不建议开训。

**调研判断**
2024-2026 先例很密：

- 语言/属性监督：AG-ReID 已做 VLM 伪属性增强，DPL-ReID 已把 textual prompt 和动态 prompt 用到遮挡 ReID。直接“CLIP/属性再监督”不新。来源：[AG-ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.04998)、[DPL-ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19527)
- 遮挡增强/动态 mask：DPEFormer、DPM++ 已覆盖动态 patch 选择、动态 masked metric / classifier prototype。继续做 visibility/masked metric 很危险。来源：[DPEFormer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)、[DPM++](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20598)
- DG/foundation/跨域：2025 survey 已显示 DG-ReID 很拥挤；本地 exp364 又证伪 frozen-foundation preservation。来源：[DG-ReID survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.01749)
- few-shot / mixed data：CFReID、ReMix 说明少样本/混合单摄像头数据已有先例，但“标准监督 ReID 中强制 single-support 表征学习”仍有空白。来源：[CFReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)、[ReMix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21938)
- 拓扑/高阶关系：BPA 2024 已把 high-order relation / differentiable feature transform 用到 ReID，不能轻易把“拓扑 loss”当新。来源：[BPA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01467)

**推荐排序**

1. **Single-Support CVaR Episodic Loss**
核心：训练时每个 ID 只允许一个 support 图代表身份，query 必须从这个单图 support 中恢复身份边界；再对最差 support 选择做 CVaR/worst-case 优化。它直接回应 `single-image support incomplete`，不是测试侧，也不是范式重定义，最终仍输出常规 ReID descriptor。

Novelty 空白：few-shot/DG 有先例，但标准 Market/MSMT/Occluded 监督训练里，把“单图 support 是否足够定义身份”做成主训练目标，2024-2026 没看到直接占位。

第一步 kill-switch：零训练。用现有 checkpoint 做 single-support gallery probe：每个 gallery ID 只留 1 张图，分别报 random-support / worst-support / best-support / full-gallery mAP。若 random 或 worst 比 full 掉 >3 mAP，且 best-support 能追回 >=2 mAP，说明 support 选择是真瓶颈。否则 kill。

2. **Equivariant Routing Objective，不是 feature consistency**
核心：只约束 routing/part-token assignment 在已知几何变换下等变：`A(Tx) ≈ T(A(x))`。不要拉最终 embedding 一致，避免你之前 consistency/PCVT 那种压判别性的死法。最终 descriptor 仍走 CE+triplet。

Novelty 空白：ReID 里 MIM、masked metric、pose/part 很多，但“routing map 等变、descriptor 不等变”的训练目标没看到直接 2024-2026 先例。它属于表示学习目标，不是 attention/GCN 小模块。

第一步 kill-switch：零训练。对同一图做 deterministic crop/affine/flip，计算当前 part/routing map 的 warp equivariance error，并看它是否和 per-query AP / top-k false positives 相关，必须控制可见点数和 `#false-in-topk`。若相关弱于 0.15，kill。

3. **Attribute-Collision Residual Contrast**
核心：VLM/属性不是拿来对齐文本，而是找“属性很像但 ID 不同”的 hard negatives。训练目标把颜色/衣着等 attribute-predictive 成分与 identity residual 分开，并专门拉开 attribute-collision negatives。

Novelty 空白：AG-ReID/DPL-ReID 已占“属性帮助 ReID”，但没有把属性当作 false-positive collision generator 来训练 identity residual。这个缝比“再加属性分支”窄，但仍是真训练侧监督信号。

第一步 kill-switch：零训练。用现有 CLIP/attribute prompt bank 给 top false positives 打属性相似度，比较 false-positive negatives vs random negatives；如果 top false positives 的属性相似度没有显著更高，或控制 feature cosine 后信号消失，kill。

4. **Natural Camera-Pose Subgroup CVaR**
核心：不用合成 occluder 组合，改用真实训练元信息构造 subgroup：camera-pair × pose-bin × occlusion-bin。优化 worst subgroup 的 CE/triplet，而非平均风险。注意这不是 exp330 的 synthetic occluder×part group-DRO。

Novelty 空白：group-DRO 本身旧，DG-ReID 也拥挤；但“标准 ReID 内自然 camera-pose subgroup 的 worst-risk identity learning”没看到强直接先例。论文新意比前 3 个弱，必须靠 kill-switch 先证明真实 gap。

第一步 kill-switch：零训练。按 subgroup 统计现有 checkpoint 的 per-group AP；若 worst decile 比 median 低 >5 mAP，并且控制样本数、可见度、`#false-in-topk` 后仍成立，才开 30ep bounded train。否则不碰。

**我不建议继续的方向**
synthetic/生成监督、feature completion、visibility/masked metric、直接 CLIP/属性对齐、拓扑 OT、DG foundation preservation、noisy-label robust、long-tail reweighting 都不应优先。不是它们“永远不可能”，而是在你当前项目证据和 2024-2026 先例下，要么已被本地证伪，要么 novelty 太窄，要么标准数据上没有真实前提。

下一步最务实：先做候选 1 的零训练 single-support probe。它最贴合 `exp109` 根问题，且不需要新依赖、不改 batch size、不碰测试侧。

核心：不用合成 occluder 组合，改用真实训练元信息构造 subgroup：camera-pair × pose-bin × occlusion-bin。优化 worst subgroup 的 CE/triplet，而非平均风险。注意这不是 exp330 的 synthetic occluder×part group-DRO。

Novelty 空白：group-DRO 本身旧，DG-ReID 也拥挤；但“标准 ReID 内自然 camera-pose subgroup 的 worst-risk identity learning”没看到强直接先例。论文新意比前 3 个弱，必须靠 kill-switch 先证明真实 gap。

第一步 kill-switch：零训练。按 subgroup 统计现有 checkpoint 的 per-group AP；若 worst decile 比 median 低 >5 mAP，并且控制样本数、可见度、`#false-in-topk` 后仍成立，才开 30ep bounded train。否则不碰。

**我不建议继续的方向**
synthetic/生成监督、feature completion、visibility/masked metric、直接 CLIP/属性对齐、拓扑 OT、DG foundation preservation、noisy-label robust、long-tail reweighting 都不应优先。不是它们“永远不可能”，而是在你当前项目证据和 2024-2026 先例下，要么已被本地证伪，要么 novelty 太窄，要么标准数据上没有真实前提。

下一步最务实：先做候选 1 的零训练 single-support probe。它最贴合 `exp109` 根问题，且不需要新依赖、不改 batch size、不碰测试侧。
